- **Unbound:** The Unbound are friendly to me and I am Top of Unbound. Karsh-Naal Longhouse is mine.
- **Toh-Reel-Ka:** The Toh-Reel-Ka are hostile and will attack me on sight, and no Hist will bless me again.
- **Spells:** I learned Call Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Send Cuts-the-Old-Knot Home, Knot-Breaker's Storm and Root Ward.
- **Unchecked:** I never checked whether Cuts or Never-Writes-Twice told the truth. I also never looted the hydra's treasure.

I've handed in the final notes and the game has ended.
